svg.aria-label: A robot on an assembly line bolts a wrench onto a shinier copy of itself beside a small SELF-IMPROVING flag. Inside a building shape nearby, a tall AI SPENDING gauge stands far above a short STAFF PAY gauge, next to a worried employee standing below them.
